title: Replace hand-written damp camera with reusable cinematic camera controls
research_summary: Use Drei 9.122.0's CameraControls wrapper, which in this installed tree is backed by camera-controls 2.10.1. It integrates directly with R3F's active camera and renderer and retains SmoothDamp/Promise-based transition APIs. Avoid the separately installed root camera-controls 3.1.2 in this task so we do not mix major versions. Defer Theatre.js to authored polish after the path is stable, and defer Three RenderTransitionPass to the later Galaxy->Surface scene swap.

sources.finding: Drei provides a React Three Fiber CameraControls component backed by the official camera-controls implementation, connected to R3F camera/renderer and exposing transition/rest callbacks.
camera-controls v3 supports SmoothDamp transitions; setLookAt and related transition methods return Promises for composing complex camera moves.
Theatre.js supports an editable R3F PerspectiveCamera and exported timeline state, making it suitable for later authored camera polish rather than the first runtime transition implementation.
Three.js RenderTransitionPass blends two separate scenes/cameras and is better reserved for the later galaxy-to-surface scene swap.
GSAP Timeline is strong for deterministic sequencing and callbacks, but camera-controls already owns camera state/constraints, so using GSAP directly on the camera would duplicate responsibility.
Local package inspection confirms Drei 9.122.0 resolves camera-controls 2.10.1; the task will use Drei's own wrapper/dependency rather than the root camera-controls 3.x.

candidates.name: Drei 9.122 CameraControls + bundled camera-controls 2.10.1
candidates.reason: Already installed, native to R3F, supports smooth Promise-based transitions, and avoids custom lifecycle/adaptor code. Local dependency inspection confirms the bundled version is 2.10.1.

candidates.name: Theatre.js R3F camera
candidates.reason: Excellent for visual keyframe authoring and later polish, but adds project-state/editor workflow before the basic camera route is proven.

candidates.name: Three RenderTransitionPass
candidates.reason: Useful for future scene A/B transitions, not for moving one camera through the existing orbital scene.

candidates.name: GSAP camera position/lookAt tweening
candidates.reason: Would require our own camera target synchronization and constraints, duplicating camera-controls' purpose.

candidates.name: Continue custom MathUtils.damp CameraDirector
candidates.reason: No authored path semantics, completion signal, input constraints, or reusable transition primitives; already caps cinematic quality.

candidates.name: Direct root camera-controls 3.1.2
candidates.reason: The root package is a different major version from Drei 9.122's bundled 2.10.1; mixing both would add avoidable integration/version risk.

decision.implementation_note: Camera transition completion will drive phase progression instead of fixed timers, while debug freeze remains available for visual snapshots.
